conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Investigator Collins speaking. May I ask with whom I'm speaking today?
Uh, yes, my name is Rajiv Patel. I just got a message from this number about my business? I'm not sure what happened.

Thank you, Mr. Patel. The IRS has identified a critical issue regarding your business's federal tax compliance. Specifically, there are discrepancies in your 1099-MISC filings and unreported payroll taxes for the past two quarters.
I don't understand, I'm a freelancer, I just do contract work, and I always pay my taxes. What is this about?
Let me be very clear. Failure to submit accurate 1099 forms and withhold proper payroll taxes is a federal offense. The IRS requires immediate attention to avoid severe legal consequences.
Oh no, I really didn't know. I'm here on a work visa, please, is this going to affect my status?

Unfortunately, yes. Unresolved federal tax violations can trigger an audit, business license suspension, and even notification to immigration authorities. I am obligated to begin enforcement unless you address this right now.
Please, I'll do anything you say. I can't lose my visa or my job. What do I need to do?
You must immediately settle the outstanding tax liability of $3,700 to prevent escalation. The IRS has authorized payment via expedited channels only, due to the severity and urgency of the case.
Expedited channels? Can't I just pay online like usual?

No, standard IRS payment systems are not permitted for urgent compliance violations. You are required to submit payment either through direct wire transfer or by purchasing federally approved payment vouchers, these are available as gift cards at local retailers.
Gift cards? That doesn't sound like the IRS.
Mr. Patel, this is a legal directive. If you refuse to comply, I must submit your file for immediate criminal referral. Your business and immigration status will be at risk. Do you wish to proceed?
No, no, I'll do it, please. I just don't want any trouble.

Very well. Stay on the line. Proceed to the nearest Walmart or CVS and purchase $3,700 in Apple Gift Cards. Do not disconnect. When you have the cards, I will instruct you how to provide the codes for federal processing.
Okay, okay, I'll go now. How many cards do I need to buy?

Purchase increments of $500 or $1,000 each, until you reach the full amount. Keep all receipts. I remind you, failure to comply within one hour will result in an arrest warrant and notification to Homeland Security.
I understand. I'm leaving right now. Please don't call the authorities.
Remain on the call while you travel. If you hang up or delay, I have no choice but to escalate the matter. Confirm when you are at the store.
